candidate.name: quarterly_profit_growth_level_acceleration_floor_2r
candidate.mechanism: weakest-link agreement between the cross-sectional rank of the already-public current profit-growth level and the rank of its same-fiscal-quarter year-over-year acceleration
candidate.formula: min(r_profit_level,r_profit_acceleration) on the exact common finite point-in-time stock-day cross-section

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold r_profit_acceleration fixed above r_profit_level and increase only r_profit_level without crossing the fixed acceleration rank.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign084_result: changes exactly with r_profit_level because the current growth level is the binding weakest link

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold r_profit_level fixed above r_profit_acceleration and increase only r_profit_acceleration without crossing the fixed level rank.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign084_result: changes exactly with r_profit_acceleration because improvement is the binding weakest link
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: quality_profit standalone and current-level-only growth factors

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Increase only the already larger component while the smaller component and all identities remain fixed.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign084_result: unchanged because the fixed minimum retains only the weaker rank
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: quality_growth, quality_score, arithmetic means, products, and fitted composites

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Swap r_profit_level and r_profit_acceleration for every stock while preserving their unordered pair.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign084_result: unchanged because the minimum is symmetric
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: signed level-minus-acceleration gaps and transition-direction contrasts

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Apply a strictly increasing transformation separately to every finite current profit_yoy state and every finite acceleration state before average-tie ranking, without changing ties.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign084_result: unchanged because both frozen components are cross-sectional ordinal ranks
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: raw percentage-point growth spreads, raw net-profit scale, and raw-value thresholds

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold profit_yoy disclosure identities, effective dates, levels, and accelerations fixed while changing ROE, revenue growth, net-profit scale, announcement crowding, every minute field, daily prices, and Candidate49 data.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: three-field quality, profit-revenue balance, scale-efficiency, event-timing, price-volume, market-peer, and prospective mechanisms

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quality_profit
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: the candidate reuses the exact current profit-growth rank meaning
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: quality_profit can be high while growth is decelerating; Campaign084 is capped by the separately ranked acceleration state

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: profit_yoy_acceleration
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: the candidate reuses the exact same-fiscal-quarter profit-growth acceleration meaning
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: acceleration can rank high after a weak base while the current growth level remains weak; Campaign084 is capped by the current level rank

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quality_growth
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: quality_growth averages current profit and revenue growth ranks. Campaign084 excludes revenue, uses current profit level plus its time derivative, and retains only the weaker rank

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quality_score
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: quality_score averages ROE, profit growth, and revenue growth levels; Campaign084 has no ROE or revenue and requires profit growth to be both strong and accelerating

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: roe_change and revenue_yoy_acceleration
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign084 reads neither ROE nor revenue and never substitutes another accelerating field for profit growth

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_profit_revenue_growth_spread_pp
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor subtracts current raw revenue growth from current raw profit growth; Campaign084 uses no revenue and combines the ordinal current profit level with its own time acceleration by a minimum

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_quality_rank_balance_3f
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: rank balance can be high when all three current states are weak; Campaign084 requires both its current and accelerating profit-growth ranks themselves to be high

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_profit_revenue_acceleration_rank_gap_2r
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign068 is a signed profit-versus-revenue acceleration contrast and can be high with weak absolute profit acceleration. Campaign084 excludes revenue and uses the minimum of profit level and acceleration ranks

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_profit_growth_roe_transition_gap_2r

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_joint_profit_revenue_growth_floor_rank

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_net_profit_scale_rank and quarterly_roe_profit_scale_efficiency_gap_2r
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: absolute accounting scale and ROE-versus-scale efficiency are invariant to the pair of profit-growth level and acceleration ranks targeted by Campaign084
